stem.text: A parachutist is falling at constant (terminal) velocity.

A.text: Gravitational potential energy is converted into kinetic energy of the air.

B.text: Gravitational potential energy is converted into kinetic energy of the parachutist.

C.text: Gravitational potential energy is converted into thermal energy of the air.

D.text: Gravitational potential energy is converted into thermal energy of the parachutist.
